svg.title: ARC Lab, compact symbol on navy square
svg.desc: ARC Lab compact symbol. Original white A-shaped arc surrounding a light blue person on a navy square.
svg.metadata: ARC Lab — AI for Responsible Care. Main lettering is Allerta Stencil Regular, matching the provided HIVE Lab reference, converted to vector outlines. Descriptor is Nimbus Sans Regular, converted to vector outlines. University of Toronto palette: navy #1E3765, teal #007FA3, light blue #6FC7EA; white #FFFFFF. SVG uses sRGB. Original A and person path geometry is preserved. Palette source: https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/communications/media/327/download?inline=.
